notes: A synthetic FastAPI service that mounts StaticFiles on a committed static/ folder and has no tests and no CI.
Discovery ran and collected nothing (run d1): the absence of tests is verified, so the evaluation is not provisional.
Implementation-linked claims rest on reading source, not instrumentation: no runtime coverage or mutation report exists.
Dimensions that grade existing tests (reliability, isolation, maintainability, debuggability, performance, test data, portability) are not assessed: there is nothing to grade.

applied_caps.explanation: Effectiveness is 1 (no tests); the cap of 4 does not bind because the overall is already 1.
Trust is 1 (nothing runs); does not bind.
Assertions is 1 (no assertion exists); does not bind.
Coverage is 1 (no route is tested); does not bind.

recommendations.title: Write the first API tests for the riskiest routes
recommendations.action: Add pytest with httpx TestClient tests for the upload, sign-in and proxy routes, through the app factory, with the network guard on.
acceptance_criteria: pytest collects and passes tests for the upload, sign-in and proxy routes
An upload with a path in its name is rejected by a test

recommendations.title: Run the tests on every pull request
recommendations.action: Add a CI workflow that installs the service and runs pytest on pull requests.
acceptance_criteria: A pull request shows a pytest check
A failing test blocks the merge

recommendations.title: Test the sign-in middleware with the real check
recommendations.action: Add tests that call a protected route without and with credentials, against the real middleware.

recommendations.title: Add a smoke test of the static front end
recommendations.action: Request / and one static asset through the StaticFiles mount and assert status and content type.
acceptance_criteria: GET / returns 200 text/html in a test

recommendations.title: Name an owner and a test layout
recommendations.action: Add CODEOWNERS for tests/ and a short CONTRIBUTING section on where API and browser tests go.
acceptance_criteria: CODEOWNERS names an owner for tests/

recommendations.title: Reassess once tests and CI exist
recommendations.action: After the first tests and CI runs exist, reassess with test source, run results and CI history.
acceptance_criteria: Reliability, isolation and performance can be scored from real tests
